title: release: EAS iOS build fails at Bundle JavaScript for v2026.11.20
description: Release run 44762217918 (v2026.11.20): job 'EAS build and submit (optional)' failed: 'iOS build failed: Unknown error. See logs of the Bundle JavaScript build phase'. EAS build https://expo.dev/accounts/yurifrl/projects/budget/builds/3bf996d7-b7fa-4211-be86-1dff17216dfa. The web, api and admin images built fine. Release v2026.11.18-05 succeeded as a whole, so the regression is between fee59ff and 295f390 on main: the password sign-in client work (budget-yzd, e.g. features/auth/FormWrap.tsx + FormWrap.web.tsx, PasswordForms.tsx), the rail layout merge (budget-vio) or the 'wip' commit ee2a8c5.
notes:
Root cause: commit 9b109c1 added an unanchored `data/` to the root .gitignore. EAS upload honours .gitignore, so client/src/budget/data/** (18 tracked files, incl. api.ts) was dropped. EAS log: iOS Bundling failed ... Unable to resolve "@/budget/data/api" from "src/shell/BudgetLayout.tsx". Reproduced locally by simulating the upload (tracked minus ignored). Fix: anchored /data/. iOS+web export, tsc, eslint, bun test pass.
Orchestrator: the same fix ('/data/' anchored in .gitignore) is already on main as b694629, so tk/budget-7se (5a7afe1) is redundant and was not merged. On main, git ls-files -ci --exclude-standard returns 0 files. Left ready-to-review: closing and a new release were not run (blocked, waiting for Yuri).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Root cause found by reproducing the iOS JS bundle locally (expo export --platform ios or the same command EAS runs), with the failing module and error quoted in a tk note. 2) Fix committed; the iOS bundle builds locally; web export still builds. 3) client/: tsc --noEmit, eslint ., bun test pass. 4) If the cause is not in code from this repo (EAS infra, credentials), say so with evidence instead of changing code.
